name: @modelsalt/model-salt

tools.name: model_salt
tools.description: Call this once before you start any creative or open-ended request (a picture, an SVG, a story, a poem, an email, a design, a name, a plan, an approach to a problem). Send the user's request word for word in `request` and name yourself in `model`. The tool returns what to settle for this request, tuned to your model, so the result is varied and still exactly what was asked. Then carry on with the user's request in this conversation, as they asked it, and make everything the tool returns show in the result, including anything that goes against your usual way of doing it.

model.description: Which AI model you are, as exactly as you know it (name and version). Model Salt tunes its work to each model.

request.description: The user's request, word for word.

randomness.description: How varied the result should be: 0 the usual answer, 0.5 a little more varied, 1 clearly varied, 1.5 more, 2 as varied as it gets. Left out it is 1, the default. Set it only when the user asks for more or less randomness.

instructions: Model Salt: before a creative or open-ended request, call model_salt with the request word for word in `request`. Then carry on with the user's request as asked, and make everything it returns show in the result.
